basic_details.job_title: RCC Thiruvananthapuram Resident Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 25 Posts

application_fee.details: The application fee must be paid via an online RTGS/NEFT transaction in favour of the Director, Regional Cancer Centre, payable at Account No: 0497053000013711 (South Indian Bank, Sreekaryam, IFSC: SIBL0000497).

age_limit.details: Candidates must be below 30 years of age as on the last date for submission of the application.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | resident staff nurse: B.Sc. Nursing, OR General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) with 2 years of experience. All candidates must possess a valid registration with the Kerala Nurses & Midwives Council.

salary_details.details: Candidates are entitled to a weekly off, 20 days of Casual Leave, and 8 closed holidays per year.

selection_process: Selection is based on applications received: if 25 or fewer applications are received
a rank list will be prepared based on a common index system using marks scored in the qualifying examination and weightage for experience. If more than 25 applications are received
selection will be made through a written test consisting of 50 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs)
and a rank list will be prepared based on test scores and weightage for experience.
Weightage for experience will be awarded for experience over and above the prescribed mandatory qualifications at the rate of two marks for each year
up to a maximum of 5 marks. For GNM candidates

weightage is calculated only for the number of years served in excess of the mandatory two-year essential qualification. A candidate who has passed the Post Basic Diploma in Oncology Nursing Course is eligible for 2 marks weightage (PBDON Certificate required).

exam_pattern.details: When more than 25 applications are received, the written test consists of 50 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs). | Nursing Foundation, Basic Sciences, Medical-Surgical Nursing, Child Health Nursing, Mental Health Nursing, Midwifery & Gynecological Nursing, Community Health Nursing, Nursing Research & Statistics, Oncology Nursing etc.

syllabus.details: When more than 25 applications are received, the written test consists of 50 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs).

how_to_apply: Visit the official portal to submit the application online.
Upload scanned, self-attested copies of the SSLC certificate, GNM Diploma or B.Sc. Nursing Degree certificate, and Kerala Nurses and Midwives Council Registration Certificate.
Upload the Experience certificate (mandatory for GNM Diploma holders, not less than 2 years).
Upload attested copies of all mark lists (yearly/semester-wise) in a single PDF.
Upload the Caste Certificate issued by the Tahsildar if claiming age relaxation.
Pay the required application fee via RTGS/NEFT online transaction.
Submit the online application on or before 19 October 2026.
important_instructions: The initial period of engagement is one year, extendable up to a maximum period of three years (in 179-day cycles) subject to satisfactory performance and institutional requirements. Selected candidates must execute a contract agreement upon joining. A candidate wishing to resign must submit one month's prior written notice; leaving without prior notice results in forfeiture of one month remuneration or equivalent. Engagement may be terminated at any time if the candidate is found non-compliant with institutional discipline, rules, and regulations. Successful completion of the Resident Staff Nurse Programme does not confer any claim or right for regular appointment in the cadre of Staff Nurse at RCC. An Experience Certificate as "Resident Staff Nurse" will be issued only to candidates who complete at least six months of service and fulfil all resignation formalities.

If more than 25 applications are received, selection will be made through a written test consisting of 50 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs), and a rank list will be prepared based on test scores and weightage for experience. Weightage for experience will be awarded for experience over and above the prescribed mandatory qualifications at the rate of two marks for each year, up to a maximum of 5 marks. For GNM candidates, weightage is calculated only for the number of years served in excess of the mandatory two-year essential qualification. A candidate who has passed the Post Basic Diploma in Oncology Nursing Course is eligible for 2 marks weightage (PBDON Certificate required).
